intro.text: A listener in dullform who sits on the Five, the listeners' ruling council in Narak.

items.text: Zuln agreed to let Eshonai try stormform and report back, but disliked what she saw and opposed changing all the listeners, enraging Eshonai. When Eshonai took control, Zuln agreed to take stormform, but Eshonai distrusted her and put her with those who refused. She likely escaped into the chasms with Thude and the other dissenters.

personality.text: Often quiet because of dullform, Zuln sees it as her duty to speak for the dullforms and for Roshar's parshmen, and serves as a reminder of the listeners' past.
